Involvement

Act One

Johl and his brother  Demir are at the east entrance to the Sunlit Wetlands, asking  Auntie Ethel where she took their sister  Mayrina. If the party interact with them, they learn that Mayrina disappeared and the last person to see her was Ethel. Throughout the encounter, Johl demands to know where Mayrina is and warns the party not to trust anything Ethel says. Ethel insists she has never met their sister but is willing to help look for her. The party have the choice of siding with Ethel to defend her, siding with the brothers, or refusing to get involved.

If the party defend Ethel, Johl and Demir accuse them of working with her and attack. The brothers must be defeated, but their lives can be spared by toggling on  Toggle Non-Lethal Attacks before landing a final blow. In this case, their corpses do not appear in the swamp, and the party can later tell Mayrina that her brothers were merely knocked unconscious. However, due to what appears to be an oversight in the game's dialogue files, she still cries out as if they are dead, and the quest journal receives the same entry as when she is told of their death.

If the party side with the brothers, Ethel chastises them and disappears in a burst of magic. The party can attempt to convince the two brothers not to pursue her into the swamp. While Demir is willing to take the party's advice if they offer to look for Mayrina instead, Johl refuses and drags his brother into the wetlands with him. In this case they die, and their bodies appear later in the wetlands. If their bodies are not found, Ethel may later claim that she sent them off to "Sutton Farm" north of Baldur's Gate, but voice actor notes in the dialogue files reveal that this is a lie and confirm that she has killed them.

If the party refuse to get involved during the initial confrontation between Ethel and the brothers, they are killed on the spot by Ethel with a poison spell.

Speak with Dead

Johl's corpse can be communed with using  Speak with Dead.

  • Who are you?
    • Johl
      Johl... cattle... farmer.
  • How did you die?
    • Johl
      Looked so... innocent. But the teeth...
  • How did you plan on killing this hag?
    • Johl
      With pitchforks. Stupid...
  • Maybe Mayrina wants to stay with Ethel?
    • Johl
      Course... 'cause she promised... to bring Rina's husband... back. But hags... lie...
  • How do you know your sister is even here?
    • Johl
      The... note...
  • What drove your sister to leave?
    • Johl
      She's scared she won't be... a good mum. But... she will. I know it...
  • Is the food here safe to eat?
    • Johl
      Apples... so red... so delicious but... ngh.
  • I found Mayrina's note. Why didn't you stop her?
    • Johl
      Tried. But Connor's death... was horrible. Guts... everywhere. Mayrina not... right since.
